FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Oregon fishing licence

Anglers aged 12 or older need a fishing licence. In 2026, most ocean finfish trips also need the new Ocean Endorsement.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Residents and non-residents aged 12 or older.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 12 need no base angling licence; species tags can still apply.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
One-day angling and shellfishany1 day$29 USD
Three-day anglingany3 days$68 USD
Non-resident annual anglingnon residentCalendar year$138 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Annual Ocean Endorsement · $9 USD
    Required for ocean finfish fishing, with salmon/steelhead-only and other stated exemptions.
  • Non-resident Combined Angling Tag · $89 USD
    Required for the covered salmon, steelhead, sturgeon and halibut activities; daily-licence provisions differ.
  • Columbia River Basin Endorsement
    Required for covered salmon, steelhead and sturgeon trips in the basin.

Saltwater

The base angling licence covers finfish in both water types. Shellfish have separate coverage, and the Ocean Endorsement can apply.

Rules visitors should know

  • Ocean fishing from beaches and jetties can require the endorsement.
  • Keeping other marine finfish removes the salmon/steelhead-only endorsement exemption.

How to buy

Use Hunt Fish Oregon, the MyODFW app, licence agents, or ODFW sales offices.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Oregon?

Anglers aged 12 or older need a fishing licence. In 2026, most ocean finfish trips also need the new Ocean Endorsement.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Oregon?

One-day angling and shellfish: $29 USD; Three-day angling: $68 USD; Non-resident annual angling: $138 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Oregon?

Use Hunt Fish Oregon, the MyODFW app, licence agents, or ODFW sales offices.
